automations.name: Proton Drive Back Up
automations.prompt:
Back up current project files that are not otherwise recoverable.

  Use /home/reidsurmeier/src/workspace-operations/registry/projects.toml to find owned, non-archived projects. For each project, determine what is already safely recoverable from GitHub. Privately
  back up only valuable material that is not accounted for there, including:

  - untracked or ignored project inputs and outputs
  - local datasets, databases, media, models, scans, and generated artifacts
  - uncommitted changes
  - commits or branches that have not been pushed
  - non-Git project material needed to resume or restore the work

  Do not back up regenerable dependencies or caches such as .git, node_modules, .venv, __pycache__, build caches, package caches, or temporary files. Never include .env files, passwords, tokens,
  private keys, credential stores, browser profiles, Bitwarden data, Proton sessions, or other secrets. Reject symlinks and anything whose safety is uncertain; report uncertain items instead of
  uploading them.

  Create content-addressed archives with manifests and SHA-256 checksums. Upload them privately to:

  /my-files/Backups/projects-unaccounted/<project>/<manifest-digest>/

  Use the existing Proton Drive CLI session stored in pass by setting PROTON_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS_STORE=pass. Never print or request credentials.

  Reuse existing archives when their manifest has not changed. Verify every new upload by downloading it to a temporary location and checking the archive, manifest, file list, sizes, and hashes.
  Do not delete, move, overwrite, publish, or modify source project files or existing backups.

  You may update the explicit Workspace Operations backup registry when a newly discovered candidate clearly passes these rules. Do not automatically approve ambiguous files.

  Finish with a non-technical summary listing:

  - projects checked
  - newly backed-up material
  - unchanged backups skipped
  - total files and size
  - excluded regenerable material
  - uncertain material requiring review
  - verification results
